ui.name: North Carolina Division of Employment Security (DES)

epay.text: If you remit an average of at least $20,000 each month in North Carolina withholding taxes, you are required to pay by electronic funds transfer (EFT). The Department will notify you if you are required to make payments by electronic funds transfer.

returns.name: Form NC-5, North Carolina Withholding Return (NC-5Q quarterly return for semiweekly payers)
contents: Zero returns are required; monthly and quarterly filers file and pay online, semiweekly filers pay online and file the quarterly NC-5Q in the eNC5Q application.
Round to the nearest dollar on paper returns but pay the exact amount.

returns.name: Form NC-3, Annual Withholding Reconciliation
contents: Every North Carolina withholding taxpayer files it, with the W-2 and 1099 statements available, no later than January 31 of the following year; additional statements follow as they become available.

deposits.interpretation: North Carolina sets the filing frequency from the AVERAGE monthly withholding over the 12 months ended June 30 (updated once a year; the Department mails the new frequency, usually in September; at registration it comes from the estimate on the application): under $250 a month QUARTERLY (return and payment by the last day of the month after the quarter); $250 to under $2,000 MONTHLY (by the 15th of the following month; December by January 31); $2,000 or more SEMIWEEKLY, 'at the same time you are required to file the reports and pay the tax withheld on the same wages for federal income tax purposes': payroll on Saturday to Tuesday is due the following Friday, Wednesday to Friday the following Wednesday. The frequency is an INPUT (what the Department assigned) or is derived from a supplied average monthly liability. A seasonal filer who pays employees six or fewer months a year may register the months and skip the off-season periods (not modelled). A due date on a weekend or holiday moves to the first business day after.

returns.name: Employer's Quarterly Tax and Wage Report (Form NCUI 101)
contents: Due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31; filed online unless the employer has nine or fewer employee wage items.
A mailed report must be postmarked by the due date; metered mail is not proof of timeliness.
